verdict.rationale: BVNK's documentation describes a sandbox environment that mirrors production but runs on test data, so users can validate integrations without financial risk. It also documents dedicated simulation endpoints for pay-ins and payouts in that sandbox. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of how sandbox credentials and base URLs are kept separate from production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The sandbox environment mirrors production but operates with test data, allowing you to build and validate your integration without financial risk.
Use the sandbox environment to test your integration safely before going live.
The sandbox environment provides a consistent simulation experience for pay-ins and payouts across all customer accounts.
To simulate pay-ins with different currencies and payment methods, in the sandbox environment, send the [`POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation`]
